description: Retrieve or filter Scopus subject classifications. Returns the original Elsevier JSON, including subject codes, descriptions, details, and abbreviations. Omit filters to list all classifications. This public endpoint does not require an API key.

abbrev.description: Case-insensitive exact subject abbreviation, e.g. AGRI.

description.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the primary subject description, e.g. biological.

detail.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the subject detail, e.g. food.

field.description: Comma-separated response fields: code, abbrev, detail, description. Use exact names without spaces; omit to return all fields.

name: subject_classifications

subject-classifications.description: Native Elsevier subject classification response, including any no-results message.

error.description: Message returned inside a successful response, such as No results found.

abbrev.description: Abbreviation of the subject area, e.g. AGRI.

description.description: Primary subject area description, e.g. Agricultural and Biological Sciences.

detail.description: Specific subject description, e.g. Food Science.

abbrev.description: Abbreviation of the subject area, e.g. AGRI.

description.description: Primary subject area description, e.g. Agricultural and Biological Sciences.

detail.description: Specific subject description, e.g. Food Science.

subject-classification.description: Matching classifications: Elsevier may return a single object, an array, null, or omit this field.

title: Scopus Subject Classifications
